pages.title: Red & Black Roulette
pages.text: Select red, black or green zero directly.

pages.title: How to play
pages.text: Choose red, black or green zero at the low controls, or right-click a numbered pocket. Set your stake and Start. The settled ball determines the result.$(br2)The terminal also offers odd/even and 1–18 / 19–36. Zero loses all outside bets.

pages.title: Event probabilities
pages.text: 37 equally likely pockets: 18 red, 18 black and one green zero.$(br2)Outside bets: 18/37 (about 48.65%), paying ×2.$(br2)Any straight number, including zero: 1/37 (about 2.70%), paying ×32.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Default Lv.4; initial stake cap 100,000. Wallet upgrades can raise it.$(br2)The result settles automatically once.$(br2)Payouts include the stake. Server rules may differ; check the live interface.
Craft, then right-click to use. Machines still require the matching wallet level.
